title: Atys son of Gyges
summary: Raleigh names Atys son of Gyges in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Atys, the sonne of Gyges, father of Sadyattes, in the third race of the Kings of Lydia. He is not Atys the father of Lydus, and not Syluius Atys. The one-word title would not say which Atys, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
